The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField
Curve type: KHA
Aquifer depth: 18.37–38.73 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately low-resistivity saturated sand layer between approximately 18.4 m and 38.7 m depth for screen placement; confirm lithology with cuttings during drilling, as this zone is most likely the productive aquifer, while the underlying highly resistive layer (>70 m) may represent a less permeable or coarser unit requiring careful evaluation before completion.
